???+ remember "Before you start, remember"

    ??? question "What must be true of two values for register allocation to place them in the same register?"

        Their live ranges must not overlap: at no program point can both hold a value that will still be read, since sharing a register would let one silently overwrite the other.

        Introduced in [C3. Register allocation I: linear scan](c3-linear-scan.md).

    ??? question "Why must a live range come from liveness analysis rather than from where a name appears in the text?"

        A value used inside a loop is live around the entire loop, beyond the last line that mentions it in the source order, because control can return to an earlier use on the next iteration.

        Introduced in [C2. Liveness](c2-liveness.md).

    ??? question "Which picture of a function shows basic blocks joined by arrows for where execution can go next?"

        The control-flow graph (CFG).

        Introduced in [Build v0.1: 7. Functions and control flow](../compiler/guide/stage-7-functions-and-control-flow.md).
